facts.text: The hotel sits on a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancun International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen.
facts.excerpt: On a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancún International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen

facts.text: Architect David Quintana filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.
facts.excerpt: He entrusted that vision to his son, architect David Quintana, who filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials, and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.

facts.text: The suites are adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans and have views of nature.
facts.excerpt: La Casa de la Playa features 63 suites designed to captivate you with breathtaking views of nature, adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans.

facts.text: Each suite's outdoor space has a large plunge pool, a hammock, an oversized daybed and a soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with honey- or mint-infused products.
facts.excerpt: The outdoor space offers a large plunge pool, hammock, oversized daybed, and soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with your choice of honey- or mint-infused products.

facts.text: The suites have a built-in jellyfish aquarium in the wall beside the bed.
facts.excerpt: drifting weightlessly through the built-in aquarium in the wall beside the bed.

facts.text: The centerpiece of the suite is an oversized winged heart sculpture handcrafted in chaquira beads by Wixarika artisans.
facts.excerpt: an oversized winged heart sculpture, handcrafted in vibrant chaquira beads by Wixárika artisans

facts.text: Suite benefits include butler service.
facts.excerpt: Butler service

facts.text: Suite benefits include a volcanic stone bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Volcanic stone bathtub

facts.text: The Beach Front Suite has ocean views and direct access to the beach.
facts.excerpt: Ocean view and direct access to beach

facts.text: The Master Suites have a spacious design and panoramic ocean views.
facts.excerpt: The Master Suites stand out for their spacious design, panoramic ocean views, and serene details.

facts.text: A rooftop infinity pool looks out over the Caribbean, and a lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea.
facts.excerpt: the rooftop infinity pool offers uninterrupted Caribbean views, while the other, lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea

facts.text: Muluk Spa has an ocean-view hydrotherapy ritual with a sauna, steam room and cold room.
facts.excerpt: Ocean-view hydrotherapy ritual: sauna, steam room and cold room

facts.text: Muluk Spa uses organic products.
facts.excerpt: We use organic products that care for both your skin and the environment.

facts.text: Muluk Spa has salt rooms.
facts.excerpt: 2 salt rooms

facts.text: Muluk Spa has mud rooms.
facts.excerpt: 2 mud rooms

facts.text: Admission to all of Grupo Xcaret's parks and tours is included in a stay.
facts.excerpt: admission to all of Grupo Xcaret’s parks and tours is included

facts.text: Curated experiences include candlelit dinners inside cenotes after the Grupo Xcaret parks have closed and private expeditions through underground caves.
facts.excerpt: candlelit dinners inside cenotes after the Grupo Xcaret parks have closed and private expeditions through underground caves.

facts.text: Guests can book a private dinner on the beach under the stars.
facts.excerpt: Savor a private dinner under the stars, featuring a gourmet menu paired with the gentle sound of the waves.

facts.text: At Tuch de Luna, Chef Martha Ortiz celebrates Mexican cuisine with an all-female team.
facts.excerpt: Chef Martha Ortiz celebrates Mexican cuisine with a talented all-female team.

facts.text: Xal, by chef Andoni Luis Aduriz, is inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia and Europe for more than 250 years.
facts.excerpt: The culinary syncretism of Mexico unfolds in a disruptive proposal at Xal, a culinary concept inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia, and Europe for more than 250 years.

facts.text: The chocolateria offers chocolate creations curated by master chocolatier Mao Montiel.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a unique sensory experience with exclusive and refined chocolate creations, curated by master chocolatier Mao Montiel.

facts.text: The shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings rather than a long walkable beach, making the pools and views the focal point.
facts.excerpt: the shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings, making the pools—and the views—the true focal point.

facts.text: The hotel is adults only, for ages 16 and up.
facts.excerpt: No, adults only (ages 16+)

facts.text: Muluk Spa is relatively compact.
facts.excerpt: Muluk Spa is relatively compact with serene treatment rooms illuminated by flickering candle-like lights.

facts.text: The hotel is part of Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: Leading Hotels of the World

facts.text: Muluk Spa was awarded Five Stars by Forbes Travel Guide in 2025.
facts.excerpt: awarded 5 Stars by Forbes Travel Guide 2025
